source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 15 (PDF 45-60), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 15 (Physical Optics) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 The wave nature of light was first proposed in 1678 by:
(1678 mein light ki wave nature (lehri fitrat) sab se pehle kis ne pesh ki?)
blocks.explanation: Light ki wave nature 1678 mein Christiaan Huygens ne pesh ki (introduction).

book_ref.quote: The wave nature of light was first proposed in 1678 by Christiaan Huygens

blocks.prompt:
2 At the time of Huygens, the more famous and accepted theory of light was:
(Huygens ke zamane mein light ki kaun si theory zyada mashhoor aur maqbool thi?)
blocks.explanation: Us waqt wave theory ke haq mein saboot kamzor tha, is liye Newton ki corpuscular theory (zarrati nazariya) zyada maqbool thi (introduction).

book_ref.quote: the Newton's theory about the corpuscular nature of light in 1672, was more famous and accepted

blocks.prompt:
3 Which experiment, performed in 1801, proved the wave nature of light?
(1801 mein kiye gaye kis tajurbe ne light ki wave nature sabit ki?)
blocks.explanation: 1801 ke Young ke interference (madakhilat) tajurbe ne light ki wave nature sabit ki (introduction).

book_ref.quote: Young's interference experiment performed in 1801 proved wave nature of light

blocks.prompt:
4 According to the chapter, Maxwell (1860) considered light to be:
(Chapter ke mutabiq Maxwell (1860) ne light ko kya samjha?)
blocks.explanation: 1860 mein Maxwell ne light ko electromagnetic waves (barqi-maqnateesi lehrein) samjha (introduction).

book_ref.quote: In 1860, Maxwell considered light to be the electromagnetic waves.

blocks.prompt:
5 In Maxwell's picture, electromagnetic waves are produced by:
(Maxwell ke nazariye mein electromagnetic waves kis se paida hoti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Oscillating (jhoolte) electric charges badalte hue electric aur magnetic fields paida karte hain jo aik doosre ko dobara paida karte hain (introduction).

book_ref.quote: the oscillating electric charges can produce changing electric and magnetic fields

blocks.prompt:
6 The quantum mechanical explanation of the early twentieth century showed that light has:
(Beesvin sadi ke shuru mein quantum mechanical wazahat ne light ke baare mein kya dikhaya?)

options.text: dual nature (dohri fitrat): wave bhi aur particle bhi

blocks.explanation: Quantum mechanics ne light ki dual nature (dohri fitrat) dikhayi: tajurbe ke mutabiq wave bhi aur particle bhi (introduction).

book_ref.quote: the quantum mechanical explanation revealed the dual nature of light

blocks.prompt:
7 Light interacts with matter as discrete, massless particles called:
(Light maadde se alag alag, be-mass zarraat ki shakal mein amal karti hai jinhein kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Light electromagnetic wave ki tarah chalti hai magar maadde se photons (be-mass zarraat) ki shakal mein amal karti hai (introduction).

book_ref.quote: interacts with matter as discrete, massless particles called photons

blocks.prompt:
8 Which pair of properties of light, studied in this chapter, is associated with its wave nature?
(Is chapter mein light ki kaun si do properties parhi jati hain jo us ki wave nature se juri hain?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter interference (madakhilat) aur diffraction (inheraaf) parhata hai jo light ki wave nature se juri hain (introduction).

book_ref.quote: In this chapter we will study the properties of light, associated with its wave nature

blocks.prompt:
9 A wavefront is an imaginary surface joining all points where the waves have the same:
(Wavefront aik khayali satah hai jo un tamam points ko jorti hai jahan lehron ka kya aik jaisa ho?)
blocks.explanation: Wavefront un tamam points ko jorta hai jahan lehron ka phase (marhala) aik jaisa ho (15.1).

book_ref.quote: A wavefront is an imaginary surface that connects all the points where the waves have the same phase.

blocks.prompt:
10 Light reaching us from a distant star has wavefronts that are:
(Door ke sitare se aane wali light ke wavefronts kaise hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: Door ke sitaron ki light plane (seedhe, hamwaar) wavefronts ki misal hai (15.1).

book_ref.quote: Plane wave fronts: Represented as a straight line like light waves from the distant stars

blocks.prompt:
11 Waves spreading out on the water of a pond from a disturbance at one point form:
(Talab ke paani par aik point se phailti lehrein kaise wavefronts banati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Talab ke paani mein circular (gol) wavefronts bante hain (15.1).

book_ref.quote: Circular wavefronts: Represented by circles as formed in water inside a pond.

blocks.prompt:
12 A point source of sound in open three-dimensional space produces:
(Khuli teen-jihati (3D) jagah mein awaz ka point source kaise wavefronts banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Teen-jihati jagah mein point source spherical (kurwi) wavefronts banata hai jo har taraf phailte hain (15.1).

book_ref.quote: Spherical wavefronts: Formed in three-dimensional space by a sound or light wave.

blocks.prompt:
13 Spherical wavefronts of sunlight can be taken as plane at the earth because:
(Sooraj ki light ke spherical wavefronts zameen par plane kyun maane ja sakte hain?)

options.text: source se faasla bohat zyada hai
light kisi medium mein chalti hai

blocks.explanation: Bohat zyada faasle par, jaise sooraj ki light, wavefronts zameen par plane maane ja sakte hain (15.1).

book_ref.quote: For very large distances, like light rays coming from sun, these wavefronts can be assumed as planes

blocks.prompt:
14 Microwaves of wavelength 2.8 cm travel as plane wavefronts, each one wavelength from the next. The distance between the 1st and the 6th of these wavefronts is:
(2.8 cm wavelength ki microwaves plane wavefronts ki shakal mein chalti hain, har agla aik wavelength door. Pehle aur chhate wavefront ka faasla kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lagataar wavefronts aik wavelength door hain; 1st se 6th tak 5 faasle: 5 × 2.8 cm = 14 cm (15.1).

book_ref.quote: The shortest distance between wavefronts is always equal to wavelength of wave.

blocks.prompt:
15 The direction in which a wave transfers energy is, relative to its wavefront:
(Lehar jis simt mein energy le jati hai woh us ke wavefront ke lehaz se kaisi hoti hai?)

options.text: amplitude ke mutabiq kisi bhi angle par

blocks.explanation: Energy ki muntaqili ki simt wavefront ke har point par perpendicular (amood) hoti hai (15.1).

book_ref.quote: Direction of transfer of energy of wave is always perpendicular to any point on the surface of a given wavefront.

blocks.prompt:
16 A line at right angles to a wavefront, showing its direction of travel, is called:
(Wavefront par amood line jo us ke chalne ki simt dikhaye, kya kehlati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Wavefront par amood line jo chalne ki simt dikhaye ray (shua) kehlati hai (15.1).

book_ref.quote: A line at right angle to a wavefront which shows its direction of travel is called a ray

blocks.prompt:
17 A straight vibrator (line source) in a ripple tank produces wavefronts that are:
(Ripple tank mein seedha vibrator (line source) kaise wavefronts banata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Line source, jaise ripple tank ka vibrator, do jihaton mein plane aur seedhe wavefronts banata hai (15.1).

book_ref.quote: A line source for example a vibrator in a ripple tank creates a wavefronts that are plane

blocks.prompt:
18 Plane wavefronts of light can be obtained by placing a point source of light:
(Light ke plane wavefronts hasil karne ke liye point source kahan rakha jata hai?)

options.text: concave mirror ki satah ke beech mein

blocks.explanation: Light ka source lens ke focal point par rakhein to doosri taraf plane wavefronts bante hain (15.1).

book_ref.quote: If a source of light is placed at the focal point of a lens. Plane wavefronts are formed

blocks.prompt:
19 A periodic source produces a succession of wavefronts that are:
(Periodic (dauri) source lagataar kaise wavefronts paida karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Periodic source lagataar wavefronts paida karta hai jo sab aik hi shakal ke hote hain (15.1).

book_ref.quote: If the source is periodic, it produces a succession of wavefronts, all of the same shape.

blocks.prompt:
20 Huygens' principle is a geometrical method for finding:
(Huygens ka usool kis cheez ko maloom karne ka geometrical tareeqa hai?)

options.text: maloom wavefront se baad ke waqt ke wavefront ki shakal

blocks.explanation: Kisi lamhe ke maloom wavefront se baad ke waqt ki wavefront ki shakal maloom ki jati hai (15.2).

book_ref.quote: is a geometrical method for finding, from the known shape of a wavefront at some instant

blocks.prompt:
21 According to Huygens, every point of a wavefront acts as a source of:
(Huygens ke mutabiq wavefront ka har point kis cheez ka source hai?)
blocks.explanation: Wavefront ka har point secondary wavelets (chhoti saanwi lehron) ka source hai (15.2).

book_ref.quote: every point of a wavefront may be considered the source of secondary wavelets

blocks.prompt:
22 Huygens' secondary wavelets spread out with a speed:
(Huygens ke secondary wavelets kis speed se phailte hain?)

options.text: lehar ki apni speed ke barabar
hamesha light ki speed ke barabar

blocks.explanation: Wavelets har taraf usi speed se phailte hain jis se asal lehar chalti hai (15.2).

book_ref.quote: spread out in all directions with a speed equal to the speed of propagation of the wave

blocks.prompt:
23 In Huygens' construction, the new wavefront is the surface:
(Huygens ki banawat mein naya wavefront kaun si satah hai?)

options.text: wavelets ke markazon se guzarne wali satah
sab se chhote wavelet ke andar
tamam wavelets ko chhoone wali satah (envelope)

blocks.explanation: Naya wavefront woh satah hai jo tamam wavelets ko chhooti (tangent) hai; ise envelope (ghilaf) kehte hain (15.2).

book_ref.quote: constructing a surface tangent to the secondary wavelets or, as it is called, the envelope of the wavelets

blocks.prompt:
24 A light wavefront moves through a medium at 2.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹. The radius of the Huygens' wavelets drawn for a time interval of 4.0 ns is:
(Light ka wavefront kisi medium mein 2.0 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹ se chalta hai. 4.0 ns ke waqfe ke liye Huygens wavelets ka radius kitna hoga?)

book_ref.quote: Then in time t the wavefront travels a distance vt.

blocks.prompt:
25 A sound wavefront AB travels at 340 m s⁻¹. To draw its position 0.020 s later by Huygens' method, circles of radius ____ are drawn with centres on AB.
(Awaz ka wavefront AB 340 m s⁻¹ se chalta hai. 0.020 s baad us ki jagah Huygens ke tareeqe se banane ke liye AB par markaz wale kitne radius ke daire banaye jayenge?)

book_ref.quote: We construct several circles (traces of spherical wavelets) with radius vt, centered at points along AB.

blocks.prompt:
26 In the chapter's Huygens construction of the new wavefront CD, the speed of the wave is assumed to be:
(Chapter mein naye wavefront CD ki Huygens banawat mein lehar ki speed ke baare mein kya farz kiya gaya hai?)

options.text: AB ke beech mein sab se zyada

blocks.explanation: Banawat mein farz kiya gaya ke speed v har point par aik jaisi hai (15.2).

book_ref.quote: We assume that v, the speed of propagation of the wave, is the same at all points.

blocks.prompt:
27 The results of Huygens' principle can also be obtained from:
(Huygens ke usool ke nataij aur kis se bhi hasil kiye ja sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Huygens ke usool ke sab nataij Maxwell's equations se bhi milte hain, magar Huygens ka model asaan hai (15.2).

book_ref.quote: All the results that we obtain from Huygens' Principle can also be obtained from Maxwell's equations

blocks.prompt:
28 Two sources are called coherent if the waves they emit have:
(Do sources ko coherent kab kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Coherent (hum-aahang) sources aisi lehrein bhejte hain jin ka phase difference mustaqil rehta hai (coherence).

book_ref.quote: Coherent sources emit waves that have a constant phase difference.

blocks.prompt:
29 Two waves can have a constant phase difference only if their:
(Do lehron ka phase difference sirf kab mustaqil reh sakta hai?)

options.text: frequencies aik jaisi aur mustaqil hon

blocks.explanation: Mustaqil phase difference ke liye frequency aik jaisi aur mustaqil honi chahiye (coherence).

book_ref.quote: the two waves can only have a constant phase difference if their frequencies are the same and remains constant

blocks.prompt:
30 Two loudspeakers connected to different signal generators of slightly different frequencies give:
(Thori mukhtalif frequency wale alag signal generators se jure do loudspeakers kya dete hain?)

options.text: tez aur halki jaghon ka mustaqil pattern
tez, phir halki, phir tez awaz, aur pattern kamre mein badalta rehta hai
har jagah aik jaisi tez awaz

blocks.explanation: Lehrein shuru mein in phase hoti hain magar jald out of phase ho jati hain, is liye pattern badalta rehta hai (coherence).

book_ref.quote: If they were connected to different signal generators with slightly different frequencies

blocks.prompt:
31 Two loudspeakers act as coherent sources when they are:
(Do loudspeakers coherent sources kab bante hain?)

options.text: aik hi signal generator se jure hon
mukhtalif frequency ke do generators se jure hon

blocks.explanation: Dono loudspeakers ko aik hi signal generator se jorne par un ki lehrein mustaqil in phase rehti hain (coherence).

book_ref.quote: By connecting the two loudspeakers to the same signal generator

blocks.prompt:
32 Two separate lasers of the same frequency are not used as the two sources in a double-slit experiment because:
(Double-slit tajurbe mein aik jaisi frequency ke do alag lasers kyun istemal nahi kiye jate?)

options.text: woh hamesha alag rang dete hain
un ke light bursts ka in phase rehna yaqeeni nahi

blocks.explanation: Laser light alag alag bursts (jhatkon) se bani hai; do lasers ke bursts hamesha in phase nahi rehte (coherence).

book_ref.quote: We cannot guarantee that these bursts from two lasers will always be in phase with one another.

blocks.prompt:
33 Coherent light sources for a double-slit experiment are obtained by:
(Double-slit tajurbe ke liye coherent light sources kaise hasil kiye jate hain?)

options.text: aik jaisi power ke do bulb
aik hi laser ki light ko do slits se taqseem kar ke

blocks.explanation: Aik hi laser ki light ko do slits se taqseem karne par slits do coherent sources ban jati hain (coherence).

book_ref.quote: This problem is overcome by using a single laser and dividing its light using the two slits

blocks.prompt:
34 If the two sources were not coherent, the screen would show:
(Agar do sources coherent na hon to screen par kya nazar aayega?)

options.text: tez mustaqil roshan aur andheri fringes

blocks.explanation: Pattern itni tezi se badlega ke aankh pakar na sake; sirf aik yaksaan roshni ki patti nazar aayegi (coherence).

book_ref.quote: We would simply see a uniform band of light, without any definite bright and dark regions.

blocks.prompt:
35 An everyday example of interference of light given in the chapter is:
(Chapter mein light ke interference ki rozmarra misal kaun si di gayi hai?)

options.text: dhundli raat mein street lamps ya chaand ke gird halay

blocks.explanation: Dhundli raat mein street lamps ya chaand ke gird roshni ke halay interference ki rozmarra misal hain (coherence).

book_ref.quote: you may have noticed haloes of light around street lamps or the Moon on a foggy night

blocks.prompt:
36 The pattern formed when two coherent waves meet, reinforcing at some points and cancelling at others, is called:
(Do coherent lehrein mil kar kahin taqwiyat aur kahin khatma karein to bannay wala pattern kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Do coherent lehrein kahin aik doosre ko mazboot aur kahin khatam karein to yeh interference (madakhilat) hai (15.3).

book_ref.quote: Two coherent waves, when meet in a region, they reinforce each other at some points

blocks.prompt:
37 Two waves each of amplitude 3 mm arrive at a point exactly in phase. The amplitude of the resultant wave is:
(3 mm amplitude ki do lehrein aik point par bilkul in phase pohnchti hain. Resultant lehar ka amplitude kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: In phase aur barabar amplitude: resultant aik lehar ke amplitude ka dugna, 2 × 3 = 6 mm (15.3).

book_ref.quote: The principle of superposition predicts that the resultant wave has twice the amplitude of a single wave.

blocks.prompt:
38 Two waves of equal amplitude 4 mm meet exactly in antiphase. The resultant amplitude is:
(4 mm ke barabar amplitude wali do lehrein bilkul antiphase (ulte phase) mein milti hain. Resultant amplitude kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Barabar amplitude antiphase mein aik doosre ko khatam kar deti hain; resultant sifar (15.3).

book_ref.quote: Blue and green waves of the same amplitude may give (a) constructive or (b) destructive interference

blocks.prompt:
39 Waves of amplitudes 2 units and 5 units meet in phase. The amplitude of the resultant wave is:
(2 units aur 5 units amplitude ki lehrein in phase milti hain. Resultant ka amplitude kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif amplitudes bhi constructive interference karti hain; in phase amplitudes jama: 2 + 5 = 7 units (15.3).

book_ref.quote: waves of different amplitudes can also interfere constructively

blocks.prompt:
40 A sound wave can produce interference only with:
(Awaz ki lehar sirf kis ke saath interference kar sakti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Lehrein aik hi qisam ki honi chahiyein; awaz ki lehrein sirf awaz ki lehron se interference karti hain (15.3).

book_ref.quote: Waves must be of same type i.e. sound waves can only produce interference with other sound waves.

blocks.prompt:
41 Which of these is one of the chapter's basic conditions for two waves to produce interference?
(Do lehron ke interference ke liye chapter ki bunyadi sharton mein se kaun si hai?)

options.text: Un ke amplitude bilkul barabar hon
Woh do alag lasers se aayein
Woh aik hi ya taqreeban aik hi simt mein chalein

blocks.explanation: Lehrein aik qisam ki, coherent, aur aik hi ya taqreeban aik hi simt mein chal rahi hon (15.3).

book_ref.quote: Waves must be moving in same or almost same direction.

blocks.prompt:
42 If two interfering waves have different amplitudes, then:
(Agar interference karne wali do lehron ke amplitudes mukhtalif hon to kya hoga?)

options.text: interference hota hai magar pattern ka contrast kam ho jata hai
andheri jagahein mukammal andheri ho jati hain
pattern Newton's rings ban jata hai

blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif amplitudes ke saath bhi interference hota hai magar roshan aur andheri jaghon ka contrast (farq) kam ho jata hai (15.3).

book_ref.quote: Two waves can produce interference if amplitudes are different but this will decrease the contrast

blocks.prompt:
43 Adding waves of different wavelengths and amplitudes produces:
(Mukhtalif wavelengths aur amplitudes ki lehrein jama karne se kya banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mukhtalif wavelengths aur amplitudes ki lehrein mil kar complex (pecheeda) lehrein banati hain (15.3).

book_ref.quote: Adding waves of different wavelengths and amplitudes results in complex waves.

blocks.prompt:
44 In the two-slit laser arrangement, the bright fringes are regions where light waves from the two slits arrive:
(Do-slit laser tajurbe mein roshan fringes woh jagahein hain jahan dono slits ki lehrein kaise pohnchti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Roshan fringes par dono slits ki lehrein in phase pohnchti hain: constructive interference (taqwiyati madakhilat).

book_ref.quote: These bright dots are referred to as interference

blocks.prompt:
45 In the sound analogue of the light fringe pattern, a dark fringe corresponds to:
(Light fringe pattern ki awaz wali misal mein andheri fringe kis ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Roshan fringes tez awaz aur andheri fringes halki awaz ya khamoshi ke barabar hain.

book_ref.quote: Bright fringes correspond to loud sound, dark fringes to quiet sound or silence.

blocks.prompt:
46 In the two-slit laser experiment, one slit is covered. A point that was at a dark fringe now:
(Do-slit laser tajurbe mein aik slit dhaanp di jati hai. Jo point andheri fringe par tha ab kaisa hoga?)

options.text: aur tez andheri fringe ban jata hai
roshan ho jata hai kyunke chauri roshni ki patti aati hai

blocks.explanation: Aik slit se fringes ghaib ho jati hain aur chauri roshni ki patti aati hai; andhera point roshan ho jata hai.

book_ref.quote: carefully cover up one of the slits so that light from the laser is only passing through one slit

blocks.prompt:
47 The broad band of light seen when only one slit is open is:
(Sirf aik slit khuli hone par nazar aane wali chauri roshni ki patti kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aik slit khuli ho to chauri patti single slit ka diffraction pattern hai.

book_ref.quote: This broad band of light is the diffraction pattern produced by a single slit.

blocks.prompt:
48 A laser is more convenient than a bright bulb for the double-slit experiment because its light is:
(Double-slit tajurbe ke liye laser bulb se zyada asaan kyun hai?)

options.text: tang aur zyada tez beam mein markooz

blocks.explanation: Laser ki light tang aur zyada tez (intense) beam mein markooz hoti hai.

book_ref.quote: a laser is much more convenient because the light is concentrated into a narrow, more intense beam

blocks.prompt:
49 In the simple laser two-slit arrangement, the separation of the two slits is about:
(Saada laser do-slit arrangement mein dono slits ka faasla taqreeban kitna hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Slits kaali slide par do saaf lakeerein hain jin ka faasla millimetre ka kuch hissa hai.

book_ref.quote: The slits are two clear lines on a black slide, separated by a fraction of a millimeter.

blocks.prompt:
50 The wavelength of the microwaves used in the chapter's interference demonstration is:
(Chapter ke microwave interference tajurbe mein microwaves ki wavelength kitni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Tajurbe mein 2.8 cm wavelength ka microwave saaz-o-saman istemal hota hai (15.4).

book_ref.quote: Using 2.8 cm wavelength microwave equipment

blocks.prompt:
51 In the microwave interference experiment, the two coherent sources are:
(Microwave interference tajurbe mein do coherent sources kya hain?)

options.text: metal ki deewar ke do gaps

blocks.explanation: Aik transmitter metal ki deewar ke do khaliyon (gaps) ki taraf hota hai; dono gaps se nikli lehrein interference karti hain (15.4).

book_ref.quote: The microwave transmitter is directed towards the double gap in a metal barrier.

blocks.prompt:
52 The microwaves spread out into the region beyond the two gaps because of:
(Microwaves do gaps ke paar ke ilaqe mein kis wajah se phailti hain?)
blocks.explanation: Microwaves dono gaps par diffract ho kar aage phail jati hain (15.4).

book_ref.quote: The microwaves are diffracted at the two gaps so that they spread out into the region beyond

blocks.prompt:
53 A probe receiver in the microwave experiment shows a region of low intensity. This is a region of:
(Microwave tajurbe mein probe kam intensity wali jagah dikhata hai. Yeh kis qisam ki jagah hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kam intensity ki jagah destructive interference (takhreebi madakhilat) hai (15.4).

book_ref.quote: By moving the probe around, it is possible to detect regions of high intensity

blocks.prompt:
54 To give an audible output, the microwave probe receiver may be connected to:
(Sunai dene wala output lene ke liye microwave probe ko kis se jora ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Probe ko meter ya audio amplifier aur loudspeaker se jora ja sakta hai (15.4).

book_ref.quote: The probe may be connected to a meter, or to an audio amplifier and loudspeaker to give an audible output.

blocks.prompt:
55 In the 2.8 cm microwave experiment, the probe is at a point where the path difference from the two gaps is 8.4 cm. The probe detects:
(2.8 cm microwave tajurbe mein probe aise point par hai jahan do gaps se path difference 8.4 cm hai. Probe kya dekhega?)
blocks.explanation: 8.4/2.8 = 3, poore wavelengths; constructive interference, is liye zyada intensity (15.4).

book_ref.quote: it is possible to detect regions of high intensity (constructive interference)

blocks.prompt:
56 With the 2.8 cm microwaves, the path difference at a point of minimum intensity could be:
(2.8 cm microwaves mein kam se kam intensity wale point par path difference kitna ho sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Minimum ke liye aadhe-adad wavelengths chahiyein: 1.5 × 2.8 = 4.2 cm; baqi poore λ hain (15.4).

book_ref.quote: Microwaves can also be used to show interference effects

blocks.prompt:
57 Thomas Young performed his double slit experiment in 1801 to show:
(Thomas Young ne 1801 mein double slit tajurba kya dikhane ke liye kiya?)
blocks.explanation: Young ne yeh tajurba light ki wave nature dikhane ke liye kiya (15.5).

book_ref.quote: He used this experiment to show the wave nature of light.

blocks.prompt:
58 For coherent sources in Young's experiment, the waves must also have:
(Young ke tajurbe mein coherent sources ke liye lehron ka aur kya aik jaisa hona zaroori hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mustaqil phase difference ka matlab hai ke wavelength bhi aik jaisi ho (15.5).

book_ref.quote: This also means that the waves must have the same wavelength.

blocks.prompt:
59 At point A on the screen, directly opposite the midpoint of the slits, the path difference and fringe are:
(Screen par point A, jo slits ke beech ke bilkul saamne hai, par path difference aur fringe kya hain?)
blocks.explanation: A dono slits se barabar faasle par hai: path difference sifar, roshan fringe (15.5).

book_ref.quote: This point is directly opposite the midpoint of the slits.

blocks.prompt:
60 At the midpoint B of the first dark fringe, the two rays have a phase difference of:
(Pehli andheri fringe ke beech point B par dono rays ka phase difference kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: B par rays antiphase mein hain, yani 180° phase difference (15.5).

book_ref.quote: the two rays must be in antiphase (phase difference of 180°)

blocks.prompt:
61 Light of wavelength 640 nm is used in Young's experiment. The path difference at the midpoint of the first dark fringe is:
(Young ke tajurbe mein 640 nm wavelength ki light hai. Pehli andheri fringe ke beech path difference kitna hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehli andheri fringe: path difference = λ/2 = 320 nm (15.5).

book_ref.quote: The path difference between the two rays of light must be half a wavelength

blocks.prompt:
62 At point C, the midpoint of the next bright fringe after the central one, the path difference is:
